newsitem.title: GREECE: CONSTANDINIDIS TO HEAD HAMBROS HELLENIC FUND MGMT.
newsitem.headline: CONSTANDINIDIS TO HEAD HAMBROS HELLENIC FUND MGMT.

text.p: Fund manager Apostolos Constandinidis took over at the helm of Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds as its new general manager, effective January 1 1997, the company announced on Wednesday.
Constandinidis, 41, has an MBA from New Hampshire College and has worked for multinationals including BASF, Bayer, Xerox and Pelikan International.
His previous posts in fund management include Ergo Invest and International Funds. He has been Hambros Hellenic's investment manager since 1994.
Hambros Hellenic has eight mutual funds and 31 billion drachmas in assets under management. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
